sources.title: 宏正自動科技2014年KVM出貨量破百萬台 佔全球出貨量55.8% 排名全球第一
sources.note: Issuer reports 1,076,530 ATEN KVM units shipped, 55.8% of global KVM shipments, and first place by annual shipment volume in 2014. This is historical shipment-volume evidence, not a current ranking.

sources.title: ATEN Ranks First in Europe and Asia for KVM Revenue
sources.effective_period: IHS KVM ranking reported in 2016; underlying measurement period unspecified
sources.note: Reports first in Asia by KVM revenue and tied for first in Europe. Asia-wide ranking is not evidence of leadership within Taiwan.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.
